description: Use when the user asks about Mahabharata stories, characters (Arjuna, Karna, Bhishma, Draupadi, Yudhishthira, Krishna, Duryodhana, Vidura...), events, or its teachings on dharma, kingship, duty, fate, loyalty and ethics. Semantic search over the complete Mahabharata (Ganguli translation, all 18 parvas). Optionally restrict to one parva (book) by name or number. Returns passages with parva and section references.
name: search_mahabharata
title: Search the Mahabharata
